headline: Approved consent agenda items, two special event permits, and a resolution on houselessness and public safety issues.
summary: The council held an executive session on City Hall security, then heard public forum comments on topics including Burlington Forward and a food program. It adopted a consent agenda covering budget transfers, a YMCA childcare lease, a utility easement, new CJC positions, and several resolutions. The council also approved two special event permits and adopted a resolution asking the state to address houselessness, mental illness, substance use disorder, and crime.
decisions: Adopted the consent agenda, which included items 6.2 through 6.17 such as budget transfers, a YMCA childcare lease, a utility easement, new CJC positions, and resolutions.
Approved a three-day special event outdoor entertainment permit for SEABA's South End Arts District Art Hop, September 11th-13th, 2026.
Approved a one-day special event outdoor entertainment permit for CSM at Opera Block in front of Pascolo Ristorante, September 18th, 5 pm - 8 pm.
Adopted a resolution requesting immediate and short-term state action on houselessness, mental illness, substance use disorder, and criminal activity affecting Burlington and Vermont.
